text:
alex: Heads-up — nightly CI is red on runtime tests, flaky failure in serve_retry_test::retry_ordering_nondet. Seen twice in the last 6 hours on runner-12 (linux-x86). Failing assert: `expected sequence [A,B] got [B,A]`

maria: ugh. which test binary / which shard? can you paste the failing log? :eyes:

alex: shard: runtime/unit-4. log snippet:```
[2026-03-18T02:10:11Z] SERVE DEBUG: sending retry #2 for req=abc123
[2026-03-18T02:10:11Z] SERVE TRACE: session=xyz, enqueue order=1
[2026-03-18T02:10:11Z] SERVE TRACE: session=xyz, dequeue order=0
[2026-03-18T02:10:11Z] ASSERTION FAILED: order mismatch: expected 0, got 1 at src/serve/retry.rs:142
```

ci-bot: rerun requested by <@alex> — job runtime/unit-4 requeued (run id 1719123461).

kevin: likely race on the retry queue. we've seen order inversion when the timer fires and a concurrent cancel/reschedule races. can you repro locally with RUST_TEST_THREADS=1? also try cargo test --test serve_tests -- --nocapture --ignored --test-threads=1 

alex: trying a 100x loop locally now with RUST_TEST_THREADS=1, will report back. short-term: can someone kick a quick bisect? i suspect changes in last 3 PRs touching retry.rs and timer.rs.

sam: i can bisect on CI, give me the range and a reproducible job trigger. alex, do you have a failing commit hash from the nightly?

alex: nightly job shows HEAD at d4b3f2a, last green at c9a1ff8. please bisect between c9a1ff8..d4b3f2a.

kevin: instrument suggestion — add a small sequence id to retry tasks and a debug print when enqueue/dequeue happen; that should show inversion when it occurs. also check for std::time::Instant vs monotonic issues across threads.

maria: if bisect finds the culprit, can we add a non-flaky unit test that forces the cancel/reschedule interleaving? prefer a deterministic repro over heuristics.

alex: local 100x run failed once with same assert — seed=842391. reproducer hint: `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo test serve_retry_nondet -- --test-threads=1 --nocapture --repeat 100 --exact`

ci-bot: bisect started by sam on range c9a1ff8..d4b3f2a, will post results.

sam: quick update — bisect narrows to commit f0e12b4 which touches timer.rs (coalescing) + a small change in retry.rs. grabbing logs now.

kevin: thanks. if f0e12b4 is it, the coalescing change could alter wake ordering. we should either revise coalescing to preserve per-session ordering or add stronger invariants in retry queue.

maria: can we mitigate with a short-term guard: when rescheduling, compare sequence id and prefer not to reorder older tasks? low-risk check for a patch.

alex: agree. i'll draft a quick fix and run the 100x loop. tagging this thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
